# Notes from the allotment

## Slugs, and what actually works

I have tried beer traps, eggshells, copper tape and a very expensive ultrasonic gadget. Only two things made a measurable difference on plot 14.

First, watering in the morning rather than the evening. Second, a single upturned flowerpot with a stick under the rim, checked each dawn. Fourteen slugs on the first day, three by the end of the month.

## Garlic in November

Plant cloves pointy end up, two fingers deep, fifteen centimetres apart. Mulch with straw and forget them until June.
